title: Advent calendar
intro: 24 doors on the visitors' page: one more opens every day from the first day. Each door holds an effect or a message; tapping an open door shows it on the matrix, in turn. Doors not open yet stay a surprise. Pick the matrix, then Save.

fields.label: Test: pretend today is door (0 = the real date)

The doors, one a line from door 1: "fx: snowfall" for an effect (snowfall, candy, retro, twinkle, fireworks, bursts, haunted, eyes, fire, lightning, firenoise, blackhole, rainbow, plasma, ripple, matrix, pacifica) or "text: Ho ho ho!" for a message (up to 30 letters)
